tagline: Quick, colourful mobile games you can play with one hand.

games.name: Evolution Race
games.short: Evolve from one cell to a whole army.
games.description: Start as a single cell and evolve your crowd into an unstoppable army. Shoot the tubes, grab the DNA, beat the boss and race through 7 worlds, from the Primordial Pond to Neon City.
features: Cell, amoeba, fish, bird, mammal, human, cyborg and more.
From the Primordial Pond to Neon City, each with its own boss.
About a minute per run, made for one-handed play.
Your progress also saves to Google Play Games.
screenshots: 7 worlds, from the pond to Neon City
Grab the loot: coins, gems and genes

games.name: Fusion Masters
games.short: Collect, fuse and battle over 120 monsters.
games.description: Pick a starter element, build your deck and fuse your monsters into stronger forms. Battle through the campaign, then take your deck to the Arena and climb the weekly ranking.
features: Over 120 monsters to collect, level up and fuse into new forms.
Fire, water, nature and dark, each strong against another.
Stages on Normal, Hard and Extreme difficulty.
Battle other players' decks and climb the weekly ranking.
screenshots: Stages on Normal, Hard and Extreme
games.credit: Fusion Masters was first made by WIP Games in 2016. Tomato Games brings it back.
